notes.content:
1: When the number of people in the room reaches 2, a prompt will be given and no one can join.
2: The gold coins obtained through local data initialization can only be obtained by verifying that it is your own steam ID when switching accounts.
3: There was a problem with the consumption of the second defense tower when it was built.

notes.title: New Feature, Core, Preview One
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZyNFY3QJVw
1: Build a defense tower
Players can use the collected wealth to build the defense towers they need. The defense towers can help you protect your home.
Building a defense tower will consume wood and stone, and during the time the defense effect is produced, wood and stone will be consumed.
2: Other players steal the wealth of their own village
Other players can enter your village. As long as other players attack the core of your village home, you will lose all stone and wood.
However, you can attack other players who steal in, but the thief cannot attack the owner of the village.
3: Collect wood and stone
Collect trees to obtain wood resources, collect stones to obtain stone resources
4: The act of obtaining valuable coins
In the process of guarding the village, you will obtain precious coins. In the future, this coin will be the virtual currency.
5: In the gameplay of protecting the village, if the player dies or the core of the village is encountered by a monster, it will lead to the failure to protect one's own village and no coins will be obtained.
If the core of your village is attacked by other thieving players or attacked by monster invaders, your village will disappear and no more coins will be generated.

notes.content:
操作方式:
1: "W", "A", "S", "D" 用于在地面移动角色
2: "T" 键, 用于飞行, 在飞行状态, "E","Q" 用于上升和下降, 再次按下 "T" , 可以降落到地面
3: "R" 是翻滚动作
4: 鼠标左键, 是攻击

The game is divided into two modes.
Operation method:
1: "W", "A", "S", "D" are used to move the character on the ground
2: "T" key is used for flying. In flight state, "E" and "Q" are used for ascending and descending. Press "T" again to land on the ground.
3: "R" is for rolling action
4: The left mouse button is to attack
